caption: The drawing depicts a single round, flat canteen-like object with four metal loops equally spaced around its perimeter. The canteen is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with concentric circles indicating its form. It features a narrow neck at the top with a circular loop handle. A ribbon or strap, colored with alternating blue and yellow-green stripes, is threaded through two of the loops, extending outward to the left and right and hanging loosely. The object is set against a plain, light beige background. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is handwritten text that reads, “HAROLD SMITH CITY MUSEUM 3 FLOOR.”
title: Canteen
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
